cd /opt/trading-bot/classic && python3 -c "
import json
h = json.load(open('hand.json'))
print(f'hand.json: {len(h)} каналов')
for x in h[-3:]:
    d = 'DEL' if x.get('deleted') else 'OK '
    a = x.get('A')
    b = x.get('B')
    pts = len(x.get('points',[]))
    print(f'id {x["id"]:2d} {x["sym"]:10s} {x["tf"]:4s} {d}  A={a is not None}  B={b is not None}  points={pts}')
"
